item.name: Get usage details for a process

request.name: Get usage details for a process

description.content: Returns usage details for the specified process including usage per machine, per user account, peak concurrent instances, and unique user count throughout the search period.

query.description: Only return usage details for the specified process version.

item.name: Get usage details for all processes

request.name: Get usage details for all processes

description.content: Returns usage details for all processes (number of unique users and, when no filters are supplied, peak concurrent users) per calendar day throughout the search period. When computerNames or userAccounts filters are supplied, peak_concurrency is omitted and the maximum date span is 90 days.
